topics.title: Howard Stern’s Tattoo Fantasy & Raven
topics.summary: During an interview, Howard recounts a bizarre evening with Dana Plato and dancer Raven where they performed nude at their table. He then fantasizes about getting tattoos using celebrity figures like Katherine Kinley from VH1 News and Julio Iglesias, imagining the process involving a ruby laser that dissolves tattoo ink.

topics.title: Restaurant Encounter & Past Lives Game
topics.summary: Diane recounts a dinner where she experienced attraction and suggestive behavior with several men, including Fred. They later played ‘Past Lives,’ a board game involving discovering past lives and potential connections to figures like Charles O’Riley, leading to discussions about money, stealing, and acquiring property.

topics.title: Traffic Updates and Absurd Conversation
topics.summary: 94 WYSP provides traffic reports detailing accidents on the Ben Franklin Parkway and delays across Philadelphia roadways. Simultaneously, two individuals engage in an extended, nonsensical conversation involving fantasy movies, celebrity roles (including Heather Lockley), and personal observations about appearance.

topics.title: Swamp Thing and Celebrity Mishaps
topics.summary: During a chaotic radio broadcast, hosts discuss Heather Locklear’s role in ‘The Swamp Thing,’ interspersed with bizarre celebrity anecdotes including speculation on Jerry Hall's BO. They debate Andy Warhol’s soup can art, Tommy Lee’s tattoo placement, tuition hikes at Queensborough Community College and a library bombing while discussing various personal experiences.

topics.title: Birth Control Discussions and Personal Habits
topics.summary: The segment centers on a meandering discussion regarding birth control pills’ potential cancer risks alongside personal anxieties about relationships and sexual practices. Participants explore suppressing orgasm and discuss various contraceptive methods with an emphasis on individual choices and perceived societal pressures.

topics.title: Radio Host Disputes & Advertising Offers
topics.summary: A phone-in segment devolves into a chaotic discussion about homelessness, the value of advertising opportunities for a local band, and bizarre dream scenarios involving attraction to radio hosts. Participants argue over low pay offers, express frustration with perceived naivete, and recount unsettling dreams regarding sexual encounters.
